assertion.statement: AllModes returns exactly the seven literal modes; all validate and the four explicitly named invalid spellings are refused.

limitations: Does not prove any executor/mode intersection, receiver, provider cursor behavior or downstream delivery.

assertion.statement: A bundle declaring check status204 rejects the actual HTTP200 response and makes exactly one request.

limitations: Only the named child refusal is executed; no other status normalization, status variant, direct operation, provider or receiver behavior is proven.
